messages.text: The process inspection confirms the remaining 4174 listener belongs to an unrelated Desktop project, so I will not touch it. The failure snapshot likewise proves 4173 served that unrelated POWERPROMPT implementation, not this workspace; I’m moving this harness to confirmed-free port 43127 with strict binding, which removes ambiguity without modifying another process.

commands.commandLine:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: playwright.config.ts
@@
-  use: { baseURL: 'http://127.0.0.1:4173', trace: 'retain-on-failure', screenshot: 'only-on-failure' },
-  webServer: { command: 'npm run dev -- --port 4173', url: 'http://127.0.0.1:4173', reuseExistingServer: false, timeout: 120_000, stdout: 'pipe', stderr: 'pipe' },
+  use: { baseURL: 'http://127.0.0.1:43127', trace: 'retain-on-failure', screenshot: 'only-on-failure' },
+  webServer: { command: 'npm run dev -- --port 43127 --strictPort', url: 'http://127.0.0.1:43127', reuseExistingServer: false, timeout: 120_000, stdout: 'pipe', stderr: 'pipe' },
*** End Patch
